subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Hypertensive disorders: preeclampsia, eclampsia and HELLP

steps.tx: **Preeclampsia** (**after 20 weeks**: BP 140 over 90 twice with **proteinuria** 300 mg or PCR 30, or thrombocytopenia, renal, liver, pulmonary oedema, headache visual; abnormal **spiral artery remodelling** with sFlt-1 PlGF imbalance) risks **eclampsia** seizures; **chronic hypertension** before 20 weeks versus **gestational** no proteinuria splits. Aspirin 150 mg high risk 12 to 36 weeks prevents; calcium low intake supplements.
steps.say: After 20 weeks pressure protein is preeclampsia: placenta fails remodelling. Aspirin early high risk prevents.

vis.alt: Chronic hypertension predates 20 weeks; gestational starts at or after 20 weeks without proteinuria; preeclampsia starts at or after 20 weeks with 140 over 90 twice plus protein 300 mg per day or PCR 30, or any severe feature. High-risk women take aspirin 150 mg from 12 to 36 weeks.
vis.caption: 20 weeks and proteinuria split the three; aspirin 150 mg prevents.

steps.tx: **Severe features** (**headache, visual blurring, epigastric band pain** liver capsule, **clonus**, platelets under 1 lakh, creatinine doubling, transaminases twice, pulmonary oedema) with **eclampsia** (**tonic clonic** seizures, posterior reversible encephalopathy, intracerebral bleed) emergencies; **HELLP** (**haemolysis, elevated liver, low platelets**, Mississippi epigastric, DIC) complicates. Reflexes brisk urine output watches; fundoscopy vasospasm grades.
steps.say: Banding epigastric headache visual seizing is severe HELLP eclampsia: reflexes brisk output watched.

steps.tx: **Magnesium sulphate** (**Pritchard** 4 g IV plus 10 g IM then 5 g 4 hourly, **Zuspan** 4 g IV plus 1 to 2 g hourly; **seizure prophylaxis and treatment**, toxicity **loss of reflexes, respiratory depression, cardiac arrest** with **calcium gluconate** antidote, urine output and respiratory rate gate) with **antihypertensives** (**labetalol** first, **nifedipine** oral, **hydralazine**, nitroprusside last; ACE banned) controls. Diazepam obsolete; fluid restriction lungs dry.
steps.say: Fits prevented treated magnesium: reflexes breathe urine gate, calcium rescues. Labetalol pressures first.

vis.alt: Pritchard loads 4 g IV plus 10 g IM then 5 g IM 4-hourly; Zuspan loads 4 g IV then 1 to 2 g per hour. Toxicity climbs from lost reflexes to slow breathing to arrest, reversed by calcium gluconate. Labetalol leads pressure control; ACE inhibitors are banned.
vis.caption: Pritchard IM or Zuspan IV; lost reflexes stop the drip.

steps.tx: **Delivery cures** (**37 weeks** preeclampsia without severe, **34 weeks** severe, immediate eclampsia HELLP pulmonary oedema DIC uncontrolled; **vaginal** stable induced, **caesarean** unfavourable emergency fetal) with **postpartum** (fits 48 hours, pressures 12 weeks chronic labels, **breastfeeding** labetalol nifedipine safe) closes; steroids 34 to 36 selected accelerate. Anaesthesia platelets gate regional.
steps.say: Cure is delivery timed severity: 37 mild 34 severe immediate fits HELLP. Postpartum fits 48 hours watched.
